item.title: Version 1.315.1
item.description:
What's New in 1.315.1

  • Microphone choice, with Automatic detection — priviSay used to listen only to the input macOS had set as its default, so a USB mic that was plugged in but not the default (a wireless-mic receiver, say) was never heard. Preferences now has a Microphone setting. **Automatic** (the default) listens on every connected built-in and USB microphone while you dictate and keeps the recording from the one that heard you; auto-stop waits until all of them are quiet. Bluetooth headsets, virtual devices and your iPhone are left out of the race, since opening a Bluetooth headset as a mic drops its sound quality; a Bluetooth headset that is your Mac's input still works. **System default** keeps the old behaviour, and you can also pin one named microphone (if it is unplugged, priviSay falls back to Automatic). Preferences shows which mic the last dictation used. With only one microphone connected nothing changes.

All transcription happens 100% locally on your device.
